summary.text: Steven Swinton, a Libertarian Party candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for North Carolina's 13th Congressional District to Paul Barringer.
He received 1.4% of the vote to Paul Barringer's 50.5%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.

He reached the November ballot after the Libertarian primary was canceled; in 2024 he was the Libertarian candidate for North Carolina Senate District 19, receiving 2,884 of 88,586 votes cast, and Ballotpedia lists no education, occupation or other biographical details for him.
